notes.title: July 2022 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to our July development update for DraeAscaria!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956220/DraeAscaria/]Wishlist on Steam[/url] 

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/draeascaria#/]Pre-Order & Beta Access[/url] 

We hope everyone has been enjoying their summer. We certainly have! (While also being thankful for air conditioning.)

Now...

Let's take a look at what we've been working on this month. (Please remember that everything is a work in progress and could change before release.)


[u][h1]Garden[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/0d9dd4b21b645160bf4ce9a1c8f7cda90bad036b.jpg[/img]

The garden has received an overhaul. Dirt plots have been removed and replaced with planter boxes. Start with a few boxes and then work towards expanding.

New crops have also been added, including the ability to grow trees and... ore!?


[u][h1]Crafting[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/d02a9d979a15154a7626612fbdd94f835bdc5e50.jpg[/img]

Attic renovations have begun! This space will be transformed into a cozy crafting area. Use the cauldron to brew up a variety of potions.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/84cb9f702ee2c178b34455f0f630ac0f12c5d656.jpg[/img]

Then move on over to the workbench and build something with the many materials found throughout the lands.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/09359979e2f4b542c60c1ba2811dd3cd8da3164c.jpg[/img]

The altar is your location to learn new spells / abilities and upgrade them to their full potential.


[u][h1]Practice Those Skills[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/309ed48c1975f712230237b14b139769d3dffa1d.jpg[/img]

After learning those new spells, why not try them out. We have added a practice dummy where you can test your abilities before heading into battle.


[u][h1]Jumping Puzzles[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/a059f88ca0b41dec3dd7739614fc437125c1b313.jpg[/img]

On your journey you may come across some glowing stones. Look around and you will find something floating nearby. Yes, jumping puzzles are being added.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/58a65cc71b46fb35567ce473c75f5062d04937b2.jpg[/img]

Can you reach the top? If so, you might be well rewarded.


[u][h1]Back Into The Ruins[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/4e64cd7bf73b56f543e569b3107d9aa3ff6da239.jpg[/img]

While exploring the ruins throughout DraeAscaria, you will come across areas which need to be interacted with using a special item or ability.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/4ee320779cfe5bdcc509c7e2bf5e271739ff4c08.jpg[/img]

Follow the hints and you just might find a way forward.


[u][h1]Good Night[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/60783a1712060321a971bf7c1b4e289979846cfc.jpg[/img]

After a long day of working your garden, crafting and adventuring, you can crawl into your bed and sleep.

There will NOT be an energy bar and sleeping is NOT required, however, sleeping will advance the time to the next morning. 

For side quests which take place over multiple days, this could help speed up the process, but you might miss out on a day of harvesting or adventuring. So sleep wisely.

----------

If you would like to connect with us directly, you can find us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/DraeAscaria]DraeAscaria[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/Mystfang_Media]Mystfang Media[/url]) or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/emGcDXNQ2V]Discord Channel[/url].


Thanks for reading,
The Mystfang Media Team

notes.title: June 2022 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first development update for DraeAscaria! (Yes, it's all one word.)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956220/DraeAscaria/]Wishlist on Steam[/url] 

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/draeascaria#/]Pre-Order & Beta Access[/url] 

This past month has been a busy one. We are excited to start showing off some of the stuff we have been working on. Please remember though that everything is a work in progress and could change before release.

With that said...

Let's take a look at what we've been working on this month.


[u][h1]Welcome to Elder Grove[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/b7b78397019503f89d11e3066d7972d3faccf06d.jpg[/img]

Your journey begins as you arrive on the shores of the Elder Grove region.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/aca9ca9c16107973f121384a561d7fa26185f602.jpg[/img]

As you travel the village streets, you'll be able to interact with the various villagers and help with many available tasks. Raise your rep with Elder Grove to unlock numerous rewards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/11d2fe2c42e2cdc7f3265c7c307d2bc45b612092.jpg[/img]

Spend the day relaxing by the water's edge, and then...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/12738e5e7e981c08a06e799e124797ea37a3e5b4.jpg[/img]

Explore the nearby ruins and discover what mysteries they hold.


[u][h1]Menus[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/546e935b4ec9608f8d547b72c0f5fa0bec77135d.jpg[/img]

The main menu and character select screens have been created. Both have real-time (dynamic) backgrounds.

Loading screens have also been created.


[u][h1]Enemies[/h1][/u]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/ede516d0c71cae3905a93ec9a216b2257b0b68b7.jpg[/img]

We have finished building and finding homes for all enemies in the Elder Grove region.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/652198de84dbb725f127a989aa7a994819b78ee2.jpg[/img]

Roaming, sensing the player, chasing and attacking have all been implemented.


[u][h1]Combat & Special Effects[/h1][/u]
The player health bar has been added and updates when the player takes damage. 

The enemy health bar has been added and updates upon receiving damage. The health bar only appears when the player is within a certain distance of the enemy. Hit and defeated animations are implemented. Upon being defeated, the enemy will now magically dissolve into nothingness.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/7079499bf742fb433f4787b7bc740cf36e32daad.jpg[/img]

Materials have been updated on tools. When starting to harvest (trees, ore), tools will magically appear in the hand of the player. Upon completing the harvest, tools will dissolve away.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42218837/8874e915d220516e8b0ef7ff06359ab4c0644a07.jpg[/img]

Materials have been updated on weapons. When starting combat, the currently equipped weapon will magically appear in the player's hand. When combat ends, the weapon will dissolve away.


[u][h1]Social Media[/h1][/u]
With the Kickstarter over, we updated all our socials (I think). We also split our YouTube channel into different channels as it had multiple topics that just didn't relate. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCONtMnt72d5bE0tSSgg4TQg]New YouTube Channel Link[/url] 

Going forward, we will only be posting videos (gameplay, trailers, etc.) related to our projects on this channel. 

As for our other socials, while we work on the game, we probably won't be posting as often (maybe once a week?). Rest assured though, that we are still here.

----------

If you would like to connect with us directly, you can find us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/DraeAscaria]DraeAscaria[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/Mystfang_Media]Mystfang Media[/url]) or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/emGcDXNQ2V]Discord Channel[/url].


Thanks for reading,
The Mystfang Media Team

It's [b]Friday!![/b] 🎉

Today we begin a new series, introducing/teasing some of the NPCs you will meet on your journey throughout DraeAscaria! 😀

[u][h1]Discord[/h1][/u]
